entities.summary: Ingrid Vang Nyman was a Danish illustrator noted for her work on the Pippi Longstocking books of which she was the original illustrator. She also adapted the stories into a comic book. Despite the worldwide fame of her Pippi illustrations, Vang Nyman did not receive as much recognition from the publication as author Astrid Lindgren, and remains fairly unknown.
